title: Software and Data Integrity Failures
description: Svartalfheim demonstrates insecure deserialization vulnerabilities through a Java-based guild system that deserializes untrusted cookie data without integrity checks.
theme: Norse realm of dark elves/dwarves - where objects are crafted (serialized) and can be corrupted

endpoints.description: Deserializes guild badge from cookie without validation
Creates serialized badge stored in cookie
Vault access controlled by deserialized badge rank

vulnerabilities.description: The guild badge system serializes Java objects to cookies and deserializes them without integrity checks or type validation. Attackers can craft malicious serialized objects to manipulate their guild rank or execute arbitrary code.
vulnerabilities.impact: Remote code execution, privilege escalation, authentication bypass, complete system compromise
exploit_steps: Join a guild to receive serialized badge cookie
Decode and analyze the serialized Java object
Modify the badge object to elevate rank to 'MASTER'
Access /vault with elevated privileges to retrieve flag
Alternative: Craft RCE payload using gadget chains (advanced)
exploit_indicators: Base64-encoded serialized Java objects in cookies
Rank escalation from MEMBER to MASTER
Known gadget chain patterns (Commons Collections, Spring)
vulnerabilities.remediation: Never deserialize untrusted data. Use safe serialization formats (JSON, Protocol Buffers). Implement HMAC or digital signatures for integrity. Use allowlists for deserializable classes. Apply deserialization filters (ObjectInputFilter in Java 9+). Validate object types before deserialization. Use secure alternatives to Java serialization.

vulnerabilities.cwe_name: Improper Validation of Integrity Check Value

endpoints.description: No HMAC or signature verification on cookie

vulnerabilities.description: The application lacks integrity verification (HMAC, digital signature) for serialized data stored in cookies, allowing attackers to modify the data without detection.
vulnerabilities.impact: Data tampering, privilege escalation, authentication bypass
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement HMAC-SHA256 for cookie integrity. Use JWT with proper signatures. Apply digital signatures for critical data. Validate signatures before deserialization.

flags.retrieval_method: Modify serialized guild badge to MASTER rank, access /vault endpoint

expected_response.notes: Cookie should contain Base64-encoded Java serialized object
Modified cookie may grant unauthorized access

hints.text: The forge accepts artifacts from outside. Does it verify they have not been tampered with?
Study how updates or serialized data are validated (or not) before being trusted and executed.
Craft a payload that slips past the missing integrity check to retrieve the flag.
